description: This Java source file defines an implementation of an authentication service that communicates over Vert.x Event Bus, verifying credentials by sending requests to a specific address. It includes classes and methods for handling authentication requests, processing JSON Web Tokens, and managing user authorities.

classes.name: EventBusAuthenticationService
classes.description: A final class implementing AuthenticationService, which authenticates users via Vert.x Event Bus communications, verifying JWT tokens and managing user authorities.

classes.name: EventBusAuthenticationService.HonoUserImpl
classes.description: A static inner class that implements HonoUser, wrapping a JWT token and its claims, providing methods for user identification and token validity checks.

methods.name: EventBusAuthenticationService(final Vertx vertx, final AuthTokenHelper validator)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the authentication service with Vert.x environment and a token validator.

methods.name: authenticate(final JsonObject authRequest, final Handler<AsyncResult<HonoUser>> authenticationResultHandler)
methods.description: Performs user authentication by sending a request over the Vert.x Event Bus and processing the reply to validate and extract user details.

methods.name: HonoUserImpl(final Jws<Claims> expandedToken, final String token)
methods.description: Constructor initializing a user instance with a JWT claims object and the original token string.

methods.name: getName()
methods.description: Returns the subject (username) extracted from the JWT token.

methods.name: getAuthorities()
methods.description: Returns the authorities associated with the user.

methods.name: getToken()
methods.description: Returns the original JWT token string.

methods.name: isExpired()
methods.description: Checks if the JWT token has expired, considering a leeway for clock skew.

methods.name: getExpirationTime()
methods.description: Returns the expiration time of the JWT token as an Instant.
